messages.subject: Full information with categoriccal data
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm running a model with ordered variables using the 'ordered' argument.
The problem is my data has around 30% of missing data, thus I lose a lot of observations. I tried using the 'missing = ML' command but it says it can't be used with categorical variables.
Is there any other approach to treat my variables as categorical and using the full information method? 
I know in Stata there's the 'gsem' command which allows it, but couldn't find any equivalent method in lavaan.

Thanks!
Eran

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Full information with categoriccal data
parts:
On 4/24/22 13:52, Eran Itskovich wrote:
> I'm running a model with ordered variables using the 'ordered' argument.
> The problem is my data has around 30% of missing data, thus I lose a lot
> of observations. I tried using the 'missing = ML' command but it says it
> can't be used with categorical variables.

True. You can use missing = "pairwise".

ML estimation for categorical data requires numerical quadrature and is
ridiculously slow in (pure) R. Nicholas Rockwood is writing a C++
implementation (glavaan), but it is not finished yet.

Yves.
